doboj.name: Doboj Project
doboj.location: Republic of Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina
doboj.title: Doboj Project
doboj.subtitle: Republic of Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina
doboj.description: High-grade mineral discovery history with significant exploration potential
doboj.overviewContent:
The Doboj Project is located in Republic of Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and represents one of Yugo Metals' key exploration assets. The project has a history of high-grade mineral discovery and is prospective for nickel, copper, and cobalt - critical metals essential for the energy transition.

The project is strategically positioned in an EU accession state, offering excellent access to European markets. Historical exploration and mining activity in the region demonstrates the mineral potential, while modern systematic exploration presents significant opportunities for new discoveries.
doboj.highlight3: Never subjected to modern systematic exploration
doboj.advantage1Description: Strategic location in Bosnia and Herzegovina, on the doorstep of the European Union
doboj.advantage2Description: Targeting nickel, copper, and cobalt - essential for the energy transition
doboj.advantage3Description: Applying systematic modern techniques to historically productive mining region
doboj.explorationProgramContent: The exploration program focuses on identifying and delineating high-grade mineralisation using modern exploration techniques. Systematic exploration program including geochemical sampling, geophysical surveys, and diamond drilling to test high-priority targets identified through previous exploration work and new geological models.

jezero.name: Jezero Project
jezero.location: Republic of Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina
jezero.title: Jezero Project
jezero.subtitle: Republic of Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina
jezero.description: Strategic exploration opportunity with historical mining activity
jezero.overviewContent:
The Jezero Project is located in the Republic of Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and is prospective for precious metals. The project benefits from historical mining activity in the region, demonstrating the presence of economically viable mineralisation.

Bosnia and Herzegovina's rich mining history, combined with its status as an EU accession state, provides an excellent environment for modern exploration and development. The Jezero Project represents a strategic opportunity to apply modern exploration techniques to a historically productive mining region.
jezero.advantage1Description: Targeting gold and silver in a historically productive mining region
jezero.advantage2Description: Region has a long history of successful mining operations
jezero.advantage3Description: Located in an EU accession state with excellent infrastructure
jezero.explorationProgramContent: Systematic exploration program to evaluate the precious metals potential of the project area. Modern techniques combined with historical data to identify and test high-priority exploration targets.

sockovac.name: Sočkovac Project
sockovac.location: Republic of Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina
sockovac.title: Sočkovac Project
sockovac.subtitle: Republic of Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina
sockovac.overviewContent:
The Sočkovac Project is located in the Republic of Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and is prospective for base metals. The project area has seen limited modern exploration despite being in a historically productive mining region.

The project represents an excellent opportunity to apply modern systematic exploration techniques to an underexplored area with significant mineral potential.
sockovac.advantage1Description: Targeting base metals in a region with proven mineral potential
sockovac.advantage2Description: Limited modern systematic exploration provides discovery opportunity
sockovac.advantage3Description: Good access and existing infrastructure supports efficient exploration
sockovac.explorationProgramContent: Systematic exploration program to evaluate the base metals potential using modern exploration techniques and technologies.

sinjakovo.name: Sinjakovo Project
sinjakovo.location: Republic of Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina
sinjakovo.title: Sinjakovo Project
sinjakovo.subtitle: Republic of Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina
sinjakovo.description: Copper-cobalt exploration project with significant potential
sinjakovo.overviewContent:
The Sinjakovo Project is located in the Republic of Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and is prospective for copper and cobalt. These are critical metals essential for the energy transition and battery technology.

The project area benefits from historical exploration data while remaining underexplored with modern techniques, presenting excellent discovery potential.
sinjakovo.advantage1Description: Copper and cobalt are essential for electric vehicle batteries and energy storage
sinjakovo.advantage2Description: Critical metals for the global shift to renewable energy
sinjakovo.advantage3Description: Underexplored with modern techniques, significant discovery opportunity
sinjakovo.explorationProgramContent: Focused exploration program targeting copper-cobalt mineralisation using modern geophysical and geochemical techniques.

cajnice.name: Čajniče Project
cajnice.location: Republic of Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina
cajnice.title: Čajniče Project
cajnice.subtitle: Republic of Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina
cajnice.description: Nickel and precious metals exploration project
cajnice.overviewContent:
The Čajniče Project is located in the Republic of Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and is prospective for nickel and precious metals. The project represents an emerging exploration opportunity in a historically productive mining region.

Nickel is a critical metal for battery technology and stainless steel production, with strong demand growth expected as the world transitions to clean energy.
cajnice.advantage1Description: Growing demand for nickel in batteries and clean energy technologies
cajnice.advantage2Description: Additional upside from precious metals potential
cajnice.advantage3Description: Early-stage project with significant exploration upside potential
cajnice.explorationProgramContent: Initial exploration program to evaluate the nickel and precious metals potential of the project area.

about.subtitle: Exploring for metals on the doorstep of the European Union
about.introDescription: Yugo Metals owns 100% of five projects in Bosnia and Herzegovina, on the doorstep of the European Union. Our projects have a history of high-grade mineral discovery and are prospective for nickel, copper, cobalt, and precious metals - essential metals for the energy transition and European supply security.
about.reasonsTitle: Six Reasons to Invest in Yugo Metals
about.reason1Description: Bosnia and Herzegovina is an EU accession state with a land border to the European Union, offering strategic access to European markets.
about.reason2Description: The Balkans is one of the world's oldest mining areas, with proven mineral wealth and infrastructure.
about.reason3Description: Yugo Metals owns 100% of all five projects, providing complete control and upside potential.
about.reason4Description: Projects explored sporadically during Yugoslav regime but never subjected to modern systematic exploration.
about.reason5Description: Highly skilled workforce, extensive existing infrastructure, and supportive regulatory environment.
about.reason6Description: Targeting gold, antimony, nickel, and copper - essential metals for the energy transition and European supply security.
about.modernExplorationParagraph1: Yugo Metals has developed a two-year technical work program, including systematic ground work, geophysical surveys, and drilling. The project was explored sporadically during the Yugoslav era, but has never been subjected to modern systematic exploration, presenting significant discovery potential.
about.modernExplorationParagraph2: The exploration program focuses on identifying and delineating high-grade mineralisation using modern exploration techniques and technologies. The region boasts excellent infrastructure and a highly skilled workforce, supporting efficient exploration activities.
about.highlight2: Strategic location in EU accession state
about.highlight4: Never subjected to modern systematic exploration
about.highlight5: Rich mining history with pro-mining environment
about.highlight6: Focus on critical metals: nickel, copper, cobalt

board.title: Board of Directors
board.subtitle: Experienced leadership team
board.description: Our board brings together decades of combined experience in mining exploration, corporate governance, and capital markets. Their leadership guides Yugo Metals' strategic direction and commitment to delivering value to shareholders.
board.director1Bio:
Sarah Johnson is a geologist with over 25 years of experience in mineral exploration and project management. She has led exploration programs across Europe, with a strong track record of discovery and resource definition.

Sarah holds a Master of Science in Geology and is a member of the Australian Institute of Geoscientists. She has been with Yugo Metals since its inception and has played a key role in the Company's exploration success.
board.director2Bio:
Michael Chen brings over 30 years of experience in mining finance and corporate governance. He has served on the boards of several ASX-listed mining companies and has extensive experience in capital markets and corporate strategy.

Michael holds a Bachelor of Commerce and is a Fellow of the Financial Services Institute of Australasia. His expertise in capital markets and corporate governance provides valuable guidance to Yugo Metals.
board.director3Bio:
Dr. Elena Petrović is a geological engineer with extensive experience in the Balkans region. She has over 20 years of experience in exploration and mining, with particular expertise in the geology and mineralisation systems of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

Elena holds a PhD in Geological Engineering and has published extensively on Balkan metallogeny. Her local knowledge and technical expertise are invaluable to Yugo Metals' exploration programs.

governance.title: Corporate Governance
governance.subtitle: Commitment to transparency and best practices
governance.frameworkContent:
Yugo Metals is committed to maintaining the highest standards of corporate governance. Our governance framework is designed to ensure transparency, accountability, and ethical conduct across all aspects of our operations.

We adhere to the ASX Corporate Governance Council's Corporate Governance Principles and Recommendations, and regularly review our governance practices to ensure they remain current and effective.
governance.boardContent: Our Board of Directors is responsible for the strategic direction and oversight of Yugo Metals. The Board comprises experienced professionals with diverse backgrounds in mining, finance, and governance.
governance.policiesContent:
We maintain comprehensive governance policies covering all aspects of our operations, including:

  • Code of Conduct
  • Risk Management Framework
  • Continuous Disclosure Policy
  • Trading Policy
  • Diversity Policy
  • Whistleblower Policy
